checked_claims.claim: Wildcard checks cover complete policy statements
checked_claims.reason: JSON checks inspect only Statement[0] and Action[0], not all statements/actions; broad validation description hides important limitations.

material_errors: JSON checks inspect only Statement[0] and Action[0], not all statements/actions; broad validation description hides important limitations.
tasks.notes: Static source review at pinned snapshot; no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Data checks iterate statements and test actions for wildcard membership (checkov/terraform/checks/data/aws/StarActionPolicyDocument.py:20-25; AdminPolicyDocument.py:20-26). JSON resource checks parse policy[0], inspect only Statement[0], require its Effect to equal Allow and its Action[0] to equal *. The admin check additionally requires Resource == * (checkov/terraform/checks/resource/aws/IAMStarActionPolicyDocument.py:15-26; IAMAdminPolicyDocument.py:15-28). Parse/shape exceptions are swallowed and the checks then pass, so this is limited pattern matching, not exhaustive IAM privilege analysis.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Checks access provider-specific nested dictionaries directly; backup validation traverses settings[0] and backup_configuration[0], returning CheckResult.PASSED or FAILED (checkov/terraform/checks/resource/gcp/GoogleCloudSqlBackupConfiguration.py:5-17). The registry selects checks by supported entity type (checkov/common/checks/base_check_registry.py:17-34), and the parser uses hcl2.load (checkov/terraform/parser.py:20-31). These explain the implementation structure, but do not establish why schema validation was rejected or prove a performance advantage.

tasks.notes: Static source review at pinned snapshot; no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: BaseRunner defines the abstract run interface (checkov/common/runners/base_runner.py:6-11). At this pin its concrete subclasses are Terraform, CloudFormation and Kubernetes Runner (their runner.py:24,16,16 respectively). Terraform uses Parser and hcl2.load (checkov/terraform/parser.py:8-31); CloudFormation uses cfn_yaml with a JSON fallback (checkov/cloudformation/parser/__init__.py:14-53); Kubernetes selects its YAML/JSON parsers (checkov/kubernetes/parser/parser.py:14-32). RunnerRegistry aggregates runner instances and their reports (checkov/common/runners/runner_registry.py:10-27).

checked_claims.claim: Sequential loops imply linear scaling and documented design priorities
checked_claims.reason: Sequential checks are evident but asymptotic behavior and maintainability motive are not established; files mode can rescan accumulated definitions.

material_errors: Sequential checks are evident but asymptotic behavior and maintainability motive are not established; files mode can rescan accumulated definitions.
tasks.notes: Static source review at pinned snapshot; no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The registry calls framework runners sequentially (checkov/common/runners/runner_registry.py:22-27). Terraform iterates files and entities, and the check registry executes applicable checks in a loop (checkov/terraform/runner.py:83-110; checkov/common/checks/base_check_registry.py:44-66). These paths contain no parallel dispatch. They do not prove linear runtime in repository size or explain the authors decision: cost depends on parsing, entity count and check work; explicit files mode even calls check_tf_definition after adding each file (checkov/terraform/runner.py:50-56).

GoogleCloudSqlBackupConfiguration supports google_sql_database_instance and checks nested backup settings without a database-version branch; its policy name explicitly targets all Cloud SQL instances (checkov/terraform/checks/resource/gcp/GoogleCloudSqlBackupConfiguration.py:5-17).
